profile: A slick, mid-tempo Latin pop/dance track with reggaeton influences. Instrumentation features a syncopated synth bass, crisp electronic beats, and bright, driving synth brass during the drop. The smooth, rhythmic male vocals are primarily in Spanish with playful English phrases. The mood is flirtatious, sensual, and club-ready. The lyrical theme centers on dancing, physical attraction, and a romantic night out. The energy arc starts with a steady, groovy verse, builds through the pre-chorus, explodes into a high-energy instrumental dance drop at 40 seconds, cools down for an intimate second verse at 61 seconds, and builds back up towards the final chorus.

key_moments.what: Section change into the pre-chorus/chorus; the vocal delivery becomes more rhythmic and repetitive ('baila baila').
Major section change; the main vocal stops and a high-energy instrumental drop with heavy synth brass, vocal chops, and a strong groove begins.
Section change; the intense drop ends and the energy pulls back significantly, transitioning into a sparser, more intimate second verse.
Section change marked by a playful vocal line ('hasta en inglés oh yes') and a drum fill, transitioning back into the driving chorus energy.

fitting_styles: Suitable approaches include high-energy dance performance (capturing the choreography and club vibe), a flirtatious narrative (a couple connecting on the dancefloor), rhythmic montage (fast-paced cuts of nightlife or vibrant, abstract lights synced to the driving beat), or bold kinetic typography (playing with the rhythm and bilingual lyrics). Clashing styles would be slow, melancholic narratives, serene nature documentaries, or anything low-energy that ignores the heavily syncopated dance beat.
